title: Weighted blow-up integrals over a Lipschitz graph converge at almost every parameter
statement: Let n, k ∈ ℕ, ι : ℝⁿ → ℝ^{n+k}, ι' : ℝᵏ → ℝ^{n+k} linear isometries with ⟨ιv, ι'w⟩ = 0 for all v, w, L ≥ 0, f : ℝⁿ → ℝᵏ L-Lipschitz, G : ℝⁿ → ℝ Borel measurable with |G(u)| ≤ C for all u. Then for Lⁿ-a.e. v ∈ ℝⁿ: f is differentiable at v, and for every continuous compactly supported ψ : ℝ^{n+k} → ℝ, ∫_{ℝⁿ} ψ(ιw + ι'(r⁻¹(f(v + rw) − f(v))))·G(v + rw) dw → G(v)·∫_{ℝⁿ} ψ(ιw + ι'(Df(v)w)) dw as r ↓ 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (L : NNReal) (G : Euclid n → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → LipschitzWith L f → Measurable G → (∀ u, |G u| ≤ C) → ∀ᵐ v ∂(volume : Measure (Euclid n)), DifferentiableAt ℝ f v ∧ ∀ ψ : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ, Continuous ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ w, ψ (ι w + ι' (r⁻¹ • (f (v + r • w) - f v))) * G (v + r • w)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (G v * ∫ w, ψ (ι w + ι' (fderiv ℝ f v w))))
